text.content: Within 7 days before the scheduled final-handover signing, an independent 验房师 performs a complete pre-handover inspection covering 15 major + 33 sub-categories per industry guideline; minimum scope includes air-quality, water-pressure 0.8 MPa × 30 min, closed-water ≥24 h, tile tap-test, electrical RCD trip-time, drainage stress test, and Shanghai-specific damp-proofing checks; fee ¥10/㎡ for 精装房 or ¥300-480 fixed for毛坯 90-150 ㎡; report incorporates Stage-1 and Stage-2 findings and closes them or escalates them to warranty register.
